layout.richText:
Brand identity is a powerful marketing tool that helps identify a company, boost recognition, and build trust. It applies to signage, packaging, logo design, and the styling of offices and exhibition spaces.

A lack of consistent brand identity hurts a company's image and creates distrust among consumers. Even small businesses — cafes, beauty salons, hotels — use brand guideline elements to establish themselves in the market.

The main objectives of brand identity:

  • Boosting brand recognition;
  • Building trust in the company;
  • Adding perceived value to the product;
  • Increasing the effectiveness of advertising campaigns.

Developing a brand guideline helps customers make purchasing decisions faster, regardless of the company's pricing.

Elements of brand identity

  1. Brand name — the foundation on which a company's uniqueness is built.
  2. Logo — the visual embodiment of the brand that makes a company identifiable.
  3. Color palette — creates the emotional tone of perception.
  4. Graphic elements — emphasize the brand's uniqueness.

Typography — a set of brand fonts that ensure a cohesive look.
